r:
policysigned

Runs TPM2_PolicySigned

-hk
signature verification key handle
-ha
policy session handle
[-in
nonceTPM file (default none)]
[-cp
cpHash file (default none)]
[-pref
policyRef file (default none)]
[-exp
expiration in decimal (default none)]
[-halg
(sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512) (default sha256)]
-sk
RSA signing key file name (PEM format) Use this signing key.
-is
signature file name Use this signature from e.g., a smart card or other HSM.
[-pwdk
signing key password (default null)]
[-tk
ticket file name]
[-to
timeout file name]

Depending on the build configuration, some hash algorithms may not be available.
